test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who was the First Governor General of free India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Mountbatten.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

__
 
• Lord Mount Batten was the first governor-general of free India.
 
• He served as the governor-general of India from 1947 to 1948.
 
• Lord Mount Batten was the last viceroy of British India.
 
• Indian Independence act was prepared under the leadership of Lord Mount Batten.
 
• Partition of India was decided by Lord Mount Batten.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord William Bentinck** was the last governor-general of Bengal.

 
 
• Lord William Bentinck was the first governor-general of British India.
 
 
 
• Lord Canning was the last governor-general of British India.
 
 
• Lord Canning was the first viceroy of British India.
 
 
 
• C Rajagopalachari was the first Indian governor-general of free India.
